title: The Brain, Body, and Behaviour Dataset (1.0.0) - Experiment 1
description: Eye-tracking recordings from 27 participants who watched five educational videos in two sessions: an attentive condition with subsequent factual multiple-choice questions, and a distracted condition where participants silently counted backwards. Data include gaze position, pupil size, blinks, saccades and fixations, together with questionnaire responses. It is Experiment 1 of the Brain, Body, and Behavior Dataset (BBBD) of multimodal recordings during educational videos.
methods_description: Participants watched five informative YouTube videos while gaze and pupil size were tracked. In the attentive session they knew they would be tested and answered 11-12 multiple-choice questions after each video. In the distracted session they rewatched the videos in the same order while silently counting backwards from a random prime number in steps of 7, with no questions afterwards.
